## Orientation

Work only in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui (HEAD e6cf774). Extend `tests/test_tmux_integration.py` in the style of `test_prefix_a_popup_redraws_as_a_task_moves_from_ready_to_running_to_done`: open the popup, press Enter on a task, and watch the detail screen update as the task moves through its lifecycle; then Esc back. The manual sign-off criterion belongs to the user; do not claim it. Capture text frames of a detail screen from the real store (read-only) in an 80-column side pane and a 160x40 pane to /tmp/dashboard-shots/ for the user's review.
